title: AI cloud startup Modal raises $750M at $15.75B valuation
key_facts: Modal Labs, an AI infrastructure provider, announced $750 million of late-stage funding.
Accel led the Series D round, joined by Kleiner Perkins and about six existing investors.
The company is valued at $15.75 billion, more than triple its value after the May round.
Modal says annualized revenue has more than tripled since May to over $1 billion.
Nearly a third of revenue comes from Sandboxes, hosted containers for AI workloads and agents.
Modal says Sandboxes ran 1 million concurrent containers in an internal test.
Funds will go to product development, including services for reinforcement learning and post-training.
quote_evidence: Accel led the Series D round.
The company says that its annualized revenue has more than tripled since the May round to over $1 billion.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows investors paying very high prices for the companies that rent out AI computing.
notes: Revenue and test figures are Modal's own claims.
